_doc: Băng Tâm Các: named spirit beasts (linh thú). Proposal, unpriced (review/RANKED.md A7, 2026-11-25; form of sects/cuu_cao.beasts.json). An owned beast is a people record with is_beast and owner_id, and its owner lists it in `beasts` (src/gameplay/character/beast_keeper.gd, assets/data/creatures_linh_thu.json). Capacity is 1 + floor(effective thần hồn / 40). In a fight it is a companion: it adds power_share (0.5) of its chiến lực to its owner's offense, strikes every basic_cooldown, cannot be targeted and never leaves the fight (Combat rule 19). `combat` and `bond` are depth fields; `bond.rider` marks a mount, `bond.keeper` a beast that is not ridden. The owners' cast records do not list these beasts yet.

beasts.appearance: A white sable draped across her shoulders, so still it is taken for a fur.

combat.note: Her Ice companion; her build's Ice stacks and companion nodes serve it and the wolf.

bond.rule: Raised from a kit inside her coat.

beasts.backstory: The sable kit Lam Tuyết Điêu carried inside her coat when she came to the Pavilion. It has grown with her into a Kết Đan beast, which no other sable of the Beast Hall has done.

beasts.species: frost wolf, leader of the Beast Hall pack
beasts.appearance: A big grey-white wolf with a black stripe down its spine and frost in its ruff.

combat.note: The frost-wolf pack leader her build's companion health and power nodes are for.

bond.rule: Raised at the Beast Hall from a pup.

beasts.backstory: Grandson of the tundra wolf that came with her from Tuyết Lang Nguyên. It leads the Beast Hall's frost-wolf pack, and it was the first to grow restless when the vein began to warm.
